title: Modeling Dynamics in Crowdfunding
authors: Chul Kim; P.K. Kannan; Michael Trusov; Andrea Ordanini
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural model of crowdfunding investment (forward-looking delay and social interactions) estimated with an IJC Bayesian algorithm. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: run.R / functions.R / functions.cpp run the simulation-and-estimation exercise that replicates Web Appendix Table 4 (100 crowdfunders x 50 periods). Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: Small simulated arrays for the web-appendix simulation study; the empirical crowdfunding data are not shipped.
data_provenance_note: Simulated data for the parameter-recovery exercise.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
